_meta.units: USD per 1M tokens, standard tier list price
_meta.rules: A hosted model runs only when its entry is verified=true, has source_url, and as_of is within ONTOLOGY_PRICE_MAX_AGE_DAYS (default 1: re-enter on run day). promo_end in the past refuses. A long_context tier with null prices refuses prompts above its threshold. premium is derived (output_per_m >= ONTOLOGY_PREMIUM_OUTPUT_PER_M, default 40) unless set explicitly. cached_input_per_m null prices cached tokens at input_per_m; reasoning_per_m null uses output_per_m. (OR) rows are OpenRouter cross-provider averages; first-party prices win.
